agent-submission.objective: Synthesize quantum state vectors and holographic boundary encodings into immutable EGG capsules. Constrain egg generation to satisfy DAG invariants from agents 1 and 2. Emit 8192 semantically distinct egg kernels for quantum-holographic computation.

inputs.input: Directed acyclic graph of quantum logic + holographic principle with 47 nodes and 63 edges
Quantum normalization + unitarity + no-cloning + CFT unitarity + Ryu-Takayanagi bounds
Kernel semantic space: 2^13 possible state configurations, 8 constraint domains

facts.fact: binary_semantic(Egg, Bit, Value) :- egg(Egg), Bit in 0..255, Value in {0, 1}

rule.head: egg(EggID)
rule.body: quantum_kernel(Kernel), holographic_map(HMap), digest_pair(Kernel, HMap, EggID), constraints_satisfied(EggID)

rule.head: constraints_satisfied(EggID)
rule.body: egg(EggID), normalized_state(EggID), unitary_kernel(EggID), no_cloning_check(EggID), cft_unitarity(EggID), ryu_takayanagi_bound(EggID)

rule.head: binary_encode(Egg, BitString)
rule.body: egg(Egg), forall(between(0, 255, Bit), binary_semantic(Egg, Bit, BitString[Bit]))

rule.head: semantics_distinct(Egg1, Egg2)
rule.body: egg(Egg1), egg(Egg2), Egg1 \= Egg2, binary_encode(Egg1, B1), binary_encode(Egg2, B2), B1 \= B2

constraints.constraint: #in_domain(Egg, state_vector) #==> normalized_state(Egg). normalized_state(Egg) :- state_vector_kernel(Egg, [A, B]), (A^2 + B^2) #= 1000.
#in_domain(Egg, density_matrix) #==> unitary_kernel(Egg). unitary_kernel(Egg) :- eigenvalues(Egg, Lambdas), forall(member(L, Lambdas), (L #>= 0, L #=< 1)).
#all_distinct([Egg1, Egg2]), #in_domain(Egg1, state_vector), #in_domain(Egg2, state_vector), Egg1 #\= Egg2 #==> \+ binary_encode(Egg1, B), \+ binary_encode(Egg2, B).
#in_domain(Egg, correlation_function) #==> cft_unitarity(Egg). cft_unitarity(Egg) :- correlation_kernel(Egg, Corr), central_charge(Egg, C), C #>= 1.
#in_domain(Egg, entropy_bound) #==> ryu_takayanagi_bound(Egg). ryu_takayanagi_bound(Egg) :- entanglement_entropy(Egg, S), minimal_surface_area(Egg, A), S #= A / 4.

proof-obligations.obligation: All quantum state eggs must have normalized amplitude vectors: |α|² + |β|² = 1 (scaled to 1000 in integer domain).
Density matrix eggs must have eigenvalues in [0,1] and sum to 1 (trace = 1).
No two distinct eggs shall have identical binary semantic encodings.
Each egg must maintain consistency between bulk quantum kernel and boundary CFT encoding.
Generate minimum 8192 semantically distinct eggs satisfying all constraints.

kernel-candidates.kernel: egg_factory(Domain, Count, EggList) :- egg_domain(Domain, DomainRange), length(EggList, Count), Count #=< card(DomainRange), forall(member(Egg, EggList), (egg(Egg), constraints_satisfied(Egg), binary_encode(Egg, _))), all_distinct_semantics(EggList).

egg_seal(EggID, Digest, Provenance, SealedEgg) :- egg(EggID), constraints_satisfied(EggID), blake3_hash(EggID, Digest), provenance_from_agents(EggID, Provenance), SealedEgg = sealed_egg( id(EggID), digest(Digest), provenance(Provenance), generation(1), timestamp(now()), immutable(true) ).

egg_verify(SealedEgg) :- sealed_egg(ID, Digest, Provenance, Gen, Time, Immutable), blake3_hash(ID, ComputedDigest), ComputedDigest = Digest, Immutable = true, Gen = 1, forall(constraint(C), verify_constraint(ID, C)).

egg_pack(SealedEgg, PackedBinary) :- sealed_egg(ID, Digest, Provenance, Gen, Time, _), binary_encode(ID, IDBytes), binary_encode(Digest, DigestBytes), binary_encode(Provenance, ProvBytes), append([IDBytes, DigestBytes, ProvBytes], PackedBinary).
